/* openCR Wiki: site-wide styles. Source: opencr-wiki repository, pages/MediaWiki__Common.css.wiki */

/* Phones and narrow windows: wide tables (field reference, sections, relations)
   scroll sideways in their own box instead of being cut off at the screen edge. */
@media screen and (max-width: 719px) {
	.mw-parser-output table.wikitable {
		display: block;
		max-width: 100%;
		overflow-x: auto;
		-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
	}
}
